The '''Mhalanduin Reformation''' was an event<ref name="Author's Cut" /> that occurred in the vicinity<ref name="Battlenamia" /> of the [[Mhalanduin system/Legends|Mhalanduin system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Oktos sector/Legends|Oktos sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="0BBY" /> a dispute involving two families had arisen over the reformation.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> Sometime between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="19BBY">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}} establishes that [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] ended the dispute over the Mhalanduin Reformation while he was serving with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which was [[Declaration of a New Order|formed]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> and 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] ended the dispute by destroying the top ranks of both involved families and subsequently appointing as [[Regent/Legends|regent]] a [[General/Legends|general]] that he himself had picked.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mhalanduin Reformation was originally meant to be introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned it was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the event was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
